user_request: 修复 Hermes 的 Langfuse 观测，让每次 LLM 请求能看出有没有启用Fast模型（比如Openai的priority）
decision: Expose request/response Fast evidence and native Langfuse TTFT/output TPS. No input rate, model behavior changes, live restart, commit, push or paid model calls.
rollback: Revert only this unit's uncommitted file hunks and new files, preserving any later unrelated work; no config or deployment rollback needed.

root_cause: Langfuse ignored service_tier/speed; response hook summaries and Responses/Chat stream assemblers dropped provider service tiers. Capped content payloads can discard the entire body.
change: Allowlisted structural request_parameters/response_parameters outside content caps; retain streamed response tier, separate fast_requested and fast_confirmed with unknown preserved.
verification: Initial ten plugin cases failed on missing fields; all passed after implementation. Large-payload hook integration then failed on dropped request tier and passed after additive hook fields. Existing retry and Anthropic usage.speed cases pass.
tradeoff: Extend existing generation identity and provider stream seams; no auxiliary coverage expansion or pricing changes.

root_cause: Existing first_chunk_at measures a network/lifecycle event, not generated output, and was not mapped to Langfuse completion time.
change: Separate first_token_at for content/reasoning/tool output, reset per API request and Codex reconnect; forward native completion_start_time and end_time.
verification: Native timing cases and stream/loop wiring failed before the corresponding fixes. Reconnect stale-token test failed then passed. Initial adjacent run: 12 files, 542 passed, zero failed.
tradeoff: Langfuse native output TPS uses output tokens / total observation latency, including initial wait; no decode-only custom rate. SDK owns generation start time. Transport-internal reconnects retain the existing one-generation boundary.

root_cause: Execution middleware runs after pre_api_request; a real SDK fixture sent default while the initial implementation recorded priority.
change: Capture only service-level scalars at the existing physical-request callback; success and error hooks reconcile generation request fields to the final physical request. Reset between API attempts.
verification: Real OpenAI SDK HTTP fixture + real plugin discovery + Langfuse 4.15.4 in-memory OTEL export: mismatch reproduced then 12 cases passed across priority/default, streaming/nonstreaming and all capture modes. Error-hook counterpart also failed before correction, then passed. Unit suites: 35 passed.
tradeoff: No new hook lifecycle, no full payload copy, no new physical-attempt spans. Existing context-detach logging appeared during real SDK integration; not part of the service/timing change, needs separate attribution before any repair.

real_sdk_integration.method: Real OpenAI SDK with deterministic HTTP transport fixtures, real plugin discovery, real Langfuse SDK with in-memory OTEL exporter; no remote writes or paid inference.

intermediate_regression: Ten legacy plugin fixture tests rejected an unnecessary model_parameters=None keyword; only send this optional update when physical request evidence exists, then reran the entire selected regression set successfully.
extra_semantic_guard: Anthropic priority capacity alone cannot confirm Fast speed; failing case corrected and included in final regression.

baseline_issue.description: Langfuse root-context detach logs across separate hook contexts
baseline_issue.reproduction: Loaded unmodified HEAD plugin into an isolated module; pre/post in separate Contexts with real SDK and in-memory exporter.
baseline_issue.decision: Pre-existing; left unchanged. Required generation fields and export verified despite this logging.

rollback: This unit's diff/new files only; shared core behavior and deployment configuration unchanged.
